item.title: Copilot Edited an Ad into My PR
item.description:
📝 After a team member summoned Copilot to correct a typo in a PR of mine, Copilot edited my PR description to include and ad for itself and Raycast. I knew this kind of bullshit would happen eventually, but I didn't expect it so soon. Here is how platforms die: first, they are good to their users; then they abuse their users to make things better for their business customers; finally, they abuse those business customers to claw back all the value for themselves.
🔗 Read more: https://notes.zachmanson.com/copilot-edited-an-ad-into-my-pr/

item.title: New Apple Silicon M4 and M5 HiDPI Limitation on 4K External Displays
item.description:
📝 0x needed for full 3840x2160 HiDPI. Diagnosis and Troubleshooting#Display Override Plist (scale-resolutions)#What: Wrote a display override plist to /Library/Displays/Contents/Resources/Overrides/DisplayVendorID-1e6d/DisplayProductID-7750 containing scale-resolutions entries for 7680x4320 HiDPI. Full reboot with the override plist in place still did not produce the 3840x2160 HiDPI mode.
🔗 Read more: https://smcleod.net/2026/03/new-apple-silicon-m4-m5-hidpi-limitation-on-4k-external-displays/
